FAIL_TO_PASS: super-class-prototype-values: correctly resolves the prototype of the super class when reading property values
return-function-deoptimization: does not deoptimize call arguments of returned functions by default
recursive-parameter-binding: Avoid maximum call stack error, make sure parameter value is optimized before hasEffects (#5499).
reassign-pattern-defaults: makes sure reassignments of pattern defaults are tracked
nested-this-expressions: properly keep or ignore nested "this"-expressions
deoptimize-conditional-expression-reassignments: tracks reassignments of deoptimized conditional expressions
no-treeshake-react: passes when bundling React without tree-shaking
namespace-reexport-deoptimization: includes namespace reexport properties accessed in try-catch callbacks
unknown-global-call: tracks argument mutations of calls to unknown globals
render-removed-statements: make sure removed statements do no leave unwanted white-space
custom-event-detail: observes side effects for custom event payloads
optional-chaining-namespace: supports optional chaining with namespace objects
deoptimize-nested-function-arg: deoptimizes call arguments to functions nested in function properties
side-effects-getters-and-setters: treat getters and setters as function calls
for-of-accessors: deoptimizes "this" for accessors triggered by for-of loops
nested-namespace-member-expression: handles accessing members of namespaces correctly
namespace-import-deoptimization: includes namespace import properties accessed in try-catch callbacks
modify-object-via-this-d: tracks object modification via "this"
reassigned-parameter-side-effect: when a parameter is reassigned, hasEffectsOnInteractionAtPath returns true
track-destructured-setter: tracks side effects from setters in destructuring assignments
